title: The Past and Present Lives of a Dog

series.title: The Past and Present Lives of a Dog

fullText.simplified:
八、快点长大

    米乐一天天地长大。这个地方有很多猫猫狗狗，米乐认识了一些新朋友。每天还会有一些哥哥姐姐来给他们送吃的，跟他们玩。但是这些都不能让米乐真的快乐！米乐每天都吃很多，他想长得大一些，长得高一些，这样他就可以出去找季南了。但是他的腿很短，他很小，米乐特别着急。
    有一天米乐看到了一个球，他跑过去咬住了球。他想起以前和季南一起玩球的时候，米乐会跑很远很远，然后季南把球扔给他。米乐跳得高高的，一下子咬住球，然后飞快地跑回季南身边。那时候，米乐是多么的快乐啊！每天下午，季南回家的时候，就是米乐最高兴的时候。米乐非常非常想季南，他想离开这里。米乐决定试试，他向门那里跑去。突然，一个姐姐站在了他的前面，一只手就把他拿了起来，送回了米乐的小房间里。米乐有点儿难过，也有点儿害怕，他不知道该怎么办。
    一年过去了，米乐觉得自己长大了一些。有一天来了几个人，他们在这些猫猫狗狗的前面看了又看。米乐知道，如果他们喜欢哪只小猫小狗，就可以带回家。米乐不愿意跟别人回家，米乐不要新主人。每次有这样的人来，米乐都走得远远的。但是这次走过来了一个小朋友，她拿着一个牛肉块。米乐闻了闻，牛肉块！他最喜欢吃的。米乐又想起了季南，季南也会给他买牛肉块吃。每次吃牛肉块，米乐都会抬抬自己的左脚，抬抬自己的右脚，然后再站起来做一个谢谢的样子，季南就会把牛肉块给他吃。
    米乐太想季南了，这次这个小朋友给他牛肉块，他也这样做了。小朋友笑了，她非常喜欢米乐，想带米乐回家。
fullText.traditional:
八、快點長大

    米樂一天天地長大。這個地方有很多貓貓狗狗，米樂認識了一些新朋友。每天還會有一些哥哥姐姐來給他們送吃的，跟他們玩。但是這些都不能讓米樂真的快樂！米樂每天都吃很多，他想長得大一些，長得高一些，這樣他就可以出去找季南了。但是他的腿很短，他很小，米樂特別著急。
    有一天米樂看到了一個球，他跑過去咬住了球。他想起以前和季南一起玩球的時候，米樂會跑很遠很遠，然後季南把球扔給他。米樂跳得高高的，一下子咬住球，然後飛快地跑回季南身邊。那時候，米樂是多麼的快樂啊！每天下午，季南回家的時候，就是米樂最高興的時候。米樂非常非常想季南，他想離開這裡。米樂決定試試，他向門那裡跑去。突然，一個姐姐站在了他的前面，一隻手就把他拿了起來，送回了米樂的小房間裡。米樂有點兒難過，也有點兒害怕，他不知道該怎麼辦。
    一年過去了，米樂覺得自己長大了一些。有一天來了幾個人，他們在這些貓貓狗狗的前面看了又看。米樂知道，如果他們喜歡哪隻小貓小狗，就可以帶回家。米樂不願意跟別人回家，米樂不要新主人。每次有這樣的人來，米樂都走得遠遠的。但是這次走過來了一個小朋友，她拿著一個牛肉塊。米樂聞了聞，牛肉塊！他最喜歡吃的。米樂又想起了季南，季南也會給他買牛肉塊吃。每次吃牛肉塊，米樂都會抬抬自己的左腳，抬抬自己的右腳，然後再站起來做一個謝謝的樣子，季南就會把牛肉塊給他吃。
    米樂太想季南了，這次這個小朋友給他牛肉塊，他也這樣做了。小朋友笑了，她非常喜歡米樂，想帶米樂回家。

sentences.english: Mi Le grew day by day. There were many cats and dogs in this place, and Mi Le made some new friends.

sentences.english: Every day, some older boys and girls would come to bring them food and play with them.

sentences.simplified: 但是这些都不能让米乐真的快乐！
sentences.traditional: 但是這些都不能讓米樂真的快樂！
sentences.pinyin: dàn shì zhè xiē dōu bù néng ràng mǐ lè zhēn de kuài lè
sentences.english: But none of this could really make Mi Le happy!

sentences.simplified: 米乐每天都吃很多，他想长得大一些，长得高一些，这样他就可以出去找季南了。
sentences.traditional: 米樂每天都吃很多，他想長得大一些，長得高一些，這樣他就可以出去找季南了。

sentences.english: Mi Le ate a lot every day. He wanted to grow a bit bigger and a bit taller so he could go out and look for Ji Nan.

sentences.simplified: 但是他的腿很短，他很小，米乐特别着急。
sentences.traditional: 但是他的腿很短，他很小，米樂特別著急。
sentences.pinyin: dàn shì tā de tuǐ hěn duǎn tā hěn xiǎo mǐ lè tè bié zháo jí
sentences.english: But his legs were very short, and he was very small. Mi Le was very anxious.

sentences.simplified: 有一天米乐看到了一个球，他跑过去咬住了球。
sentences.traditional: 有一天米樂看到了一個球，他跑過去咬住了球。
sentences.pinyin: yǒu yì tiān mǐ lè kàn dào le yí ge qiú tā pǎo guò qu yǎo zhù le qiú
sentences.english: One day, Mi Le saw a ball, and he ran over and took the ball in his mouth.

sentences.simplified: 他想起以前和季南一起玩球的时候，米乐会跑很远很远，然后季南把球扔给他。
sentences.traditional: 他想起以前和季南一起玩球的時候，米樂會跑很遠很遠，然後季南把球扔給他。

sentences.english: He remembered when he used to play ball with Ji Nan, Mi Le would run far, far away, and then Ji Nan would throw the ball to him.

sentences.simplified: 米乐跳得高高的，一下子咬住球，然后飞快地跑回季南身边。
sentences.traditional: 米樂跳得高高的，一下子咬住球，然後飛快地跑回季南身邊。
sentences.pinyin: mǐ lè tiào de gāo gāo de yí xià zi yǎo zhù qiú rán hòu fēi kuài de pǎo huí jì nán shēn biān
sentences.english: Mi Le would jump high and all of a sudden take the ball in his mouth. Then he would run back to Ji Nan at lightning speed.

sentences.simplified: 那时候，米乐是多么的快乐啊！每天下午，季南回家的时候，就是米乐最高兴的时候。
sentences.traditional: 那時候，米樂是多麼的快樂啊！每天下午，季南回家的時候，就是米樂最高興的時候。
sentences.pinyin: nà shí hou mǐ lè shì duō me de kuài lè a měi tiān xià wǔ jì nán huí jiā de shí hou jiù shì mǐ lè zuì gāo xìng de shí hou
sentences.english: How happy Mi Le was back then! Every afternoon, when Ji Nan came home, that’s when Mi Le was happiest.

sentences.simplified: 米乐非常非常想季南，他想离开这里。
sentences.traditional: 米樂非常非常想季南，他想離開這裡。
sentences.pinyin: mǐ lè fēi cháng fēi cháng xiǎng jì nán tā xiǎng lí kāi zhè lǐ
sentences.english: Mi Le missed Ji Nan very, very much, and he wanted to leave this place.

sentences.simplified: 米乐决定试试，他向门那里跑去。
sentences.traditional: 米樂決定試試，他向門那裡跑去。
sentences.pinyin: mǐ lè jué dìng shì shi tā xiàng mén nà lǐ pǎo qù
sentences.english: Mi Le decided to give it a try. He ran toward the gate.

sentences.simplified: 突然，一个姐姐站在了他的前面，一只手就把他拿了起来，送回了米乐的小房间里。
sentences.traditional: 突然，一個姐姐站在了他的前面，一隻手就把他拿了起來，送回了米樂的小房間裡。
sentences.pinyin: tū rán yí ge jiě jie zhàn zài le tā de qián miàn yì zhī shǒu jiù bǎ tā ná le qǐ lái sòng huí le mǐ lè de xiǎo fáng jiān lǐ
sentences.english: Suddenly, an older girl stood in front of him. She picked him up with one hand and sent him back to Mi Le’s small room.

sentences.simplified: 米乐有点儿难过，也有点儿害怕，他不知道该怎么办。
sentences.traditional: 米樂有點兒難過，也有點兒害怕，他不知道該怎麼辦。
sentences.pinyin: mǐ lè yǒu diǎn'r nán guò yě yǒu diǎn'r hài pà tā bù zhī dào gāi zěn me bàn
sentences.english: Mi Le was a little sad and also a little scared. He didn’t know what to do.

sentences.simplified: 一年过去了，米乐觉得自己长大了一些。
sentences.traditional: 一年過去了，米樂覺得自己長大了一些。
sentences.pinyin: yì nián guò qù le mǐ lè jué de zì jǐ zhǎng dà le yì xiē
sentences.english: A year passed, and Mi Le thought that he had grown up a bit.

sentences.simplified: 有一天来了几个人，他们在这些猫猫狗狗的前面看了又看。
sentences.traditional: 有一天來了幾個人，他們在這些貓貓狗狗的前面看了又看。
sentences.pinyin: yǒu yì tiān lái le jǐ ge rén tā men zài zhè xiē māo māo gǒu gǒu de qián miàn kàn le yòu kàn
sentences.english: One day, several people came. They looked again and again at the cats and dogs in front of them.

sentences.simplified: 米乐知道，如果他们喜欢哪只小猫小狗，就可以带回家。
sentences.traditional: 米樂知道，如果他們喜歡哪隻小貓小狗，就可以帶回家。
sentences.pinyin: mǐ lè zhī dào rú guǒ tā men xǐ huan nǎ zhī xiǎo māo xiǎo gǒu jiù kě yǐ dài huí jiā
sentences.english: Mi Le knew that if they liked any of the kittens or puppies, they could take them home.

sentences.simplified: 米乐不愿意跟别人回家，米乐不要新主人。
sentences.traditional: 米樂不願意跟別人回家，米樂不要新主人。
sentences.pinyin: mǐ lè bú yuàn yì gēn bié ren huí jiā mǐ lè bú yào xīn zhǔ rén
sentences.english: Mi Le was not willing to go home with anyone else. Mi Le did not want a new owner.

sentences.simplified: 每次有这样的人来，米乐都走得远远的。
sentences.traditional: 每次有這樣的人來，米樂都走得遠遠的。
sentences.pinyin: měi cì yǒu zhè yàng de rén lái mǐ lè dōu zǒu de yuǎn yuǎn de
sentences.english: Every time such a person came, Mi Le would walk far away.

sentences.simplified: 但是这次走过来了一个小朋友，她拿着一个牛肉块。
sentences.traditional: 但是這次走過來了一個小朋友，她拿著一個牛肉塊。
sentences.pinyin: dàn shì zhè cì zǒu guò lái le yí ge xiǎo péng you tā ná zhe yí ge niú ròu kuài
sentences.english: But this time, a child came along, and she was holding a piece of beef.

sentences.simplified: 米乐闻了闻，牛肉块！他最喜欢吃的。
sentences.traditional: 米樂聞了聞，牛肉塊！他最喜歡吃的。
sentences.pinyin: mǐ lè wén le wén niú ròu kuài tā zuì xǐ huan chī de
sentences.english: Mi Le smelled it, a piece of beef! His favorite food.

sentences.simplified: 米乐又想起了季南，季南也会给他买牛肉块吃。
sentences.traditional: 米樂又想起了季南，季南也會給他買牛肉塊吃。
sentences.pinyin: mǐ lè yòu xiǎng qǐ le jì nán jì nán yě huì gěi tā mǎi niú ròu kuài chī
sentences.english: Mi Le thought of Ji Nan again. Ji Nan would also buy him pieces of beef to eat.

sentences.simplified: 每次吃牛肉块，米乐都会抬抬自己的左脚，抬抬自己的右脚，
sentences.traditional: 每次吃牛肉塊，米樂都會抬抬自己的左腳，抬抬自己的右腳，
sentences.pinyin: měi cì chī niú ròu kuài mǐ lè dōu huì tái tái zì jǐ de zuǒ jiǎo tái tái zì jǐ de yòu jiǎo
sentences.english: Every time he ate a piece of beef, Mi Le would lift his left paw, then lift his right paw.

sentences.simplified: 然后再站起来做一个谢谢的样子，季南就会把牛肉块给他吃。
sentences.traditional: 然後再站起來做一個謝謝的樣子，季南就會把牛肉塊給他吃。
sentences.pinyin: rán hòu zài zhàn qǐ lái zuò yí ge xiè xie de yàng zi jì nán jiù huì bǎ niú ròu kuài gěi tā chī
sentences.english: Then he would stand up to say thank you, and Ji Nan would give him the piece of beef to eat.

sentences.simplified: 米乐太想季南了，这次这个小朋友给他牛肉块，他也这样做了。
sentences.traditional: 米樂太想季南了，這次這個小朋友給他牛肉塊，他也這樣做了。
sentences.pinyin: mǐ lè tài xiǎng jì nán le zhè cì zhè ge xiǎo péng you gěi tā niú ròu kuài tā yě zhè yàng zuò le
sentences.english: Mi Le really missed Ji Nan too much. This time when the child gave him a piece of beef, he did the same thing.

sentences.simplified: 小朋友笑了，她非常喜欢米乐，想带米乐回家。
sentences.traditional: 小朋友笑了，她非常喜歡米樂，想帶米樂回家。
sentences.pinyin: xiǎo péng you xiào le tā fēi cháng xǐ huan mǐ lè xiǎng dài mǐ lè huí jiā
sentences.english: The child smiled. She really liked Mi Le and wanted to take Mi Le home.

sentence_translations: (8) Grow Up Faster
Mi Le grew day by day. There were many cats and dogs in this place, and Mi Le made some new friends.
Every day, some older boys and girls would come to bring them food and play with them.
But none of this could really make Mi Le happy!
Mi Le ate a lot every day. He wanted to grow a bit bigger and a bit taller so he could go out and look for Ji Nan.
But his legs were very short, and he was very small. Mi Le was very anxious.
One day, Mi Le saw a ball, and he ran over and took the ball in his mouth.
He remembered when he used to play ball with Ji Nan, Mi Le would run far, far away, and then Ji Nan would throw the ball to him.
Mi Le would jump high and all of a sudden take the ball in his mouth. Then he would run back to Ji Nan at lightning speed.
How happy Mi Le was back then! Every afternoon, when Ji Nan came home, that’s when Mi Le was happiest.
Mi Le missed Ji Nan very, very much, and he wanted to leave this place.
Mi Le decided to give it a try. He ran toward the gate.
Suddenly, an older girl stood in front of him. She picked him up with one hand and sent him back to Mi Le’s small room.
Mi Le was a little sad and also a little scared. He didn’t know what to do.
A year passed, and Mi Le thought that he had grown up a bit.
One day, several people came. They looked again and again at the cats and dogs in front of them.
Mi Le knew that if they liked any of the kittens or puppies, they could take them home.
Mi Le was not willing to go home with anyone else. Mi Le did not want a new owner.
Every time such a person came, Mi Le would walk far away.
But this time, a child came along, and she was holding a piece of beef.
Mi Le smelled it, a piece of beef! His favorite food.
Mi Le thought of Ji Nan again. Ji Nan would also buy him pieces of beef to eat.
Every time he ate a piece of beef, Mi Le would lift his left paw, then lift his right paw.
Then he would stand up to say thank you, and Ji Nan would give him the piece of beef to eat.
Mi Le really missed Ji Nan too much. This time when the child gave him a piece of beef, he did the same thing.
The child smiled. She really liked Mi Le and wanted to take Mi Le home.
